production_basis: Puglisi's reported physical examination and classification among overfired wasters. General criteria on213 include heat-altered porous/swollen fabric, dark/greenish colour, sharp fractures and distortion; the entry is not a new autopsy by this investigator.
limitation: An independent ceramic production comparator exists at type/category level. Its missing legs and different preserved body/handle features do not supply an exact A410 counterexample.
